name: Ray-Point Distance Test
aliases: Point-Ray Distance Test for Selection Highlighting
definition: A fragment shader technique that tests whether a viewing ray passes within a specified radius of up to 10 pre-selected 3D points, outputting a binary highlight color (red or green) to indicate selection proximity.
summary: The Ray-Point Distance Test is a fragment shader technique that determines if a viewing ray passes within a specified radius of a small, fixed set of pre-selected 3D points to output a binary highlight color.
